upstream.note: CARTO publishes one OpenAPI 3.0 reference per Engine API. specUrl/contentHash name the primary one, the SQL API the adaptor calls (upstream.yaml). The Maps, Import and Auth API references are committed verbatim as upstream-maps.yaml, upstream-import.yaml and upstream-auth.yaml; their URLs and sha256 hashes are in attempts[].

attempts.note: Vendor-published SQL API reference (OpenAPI 3.0.0, the file the Redoc page at carto.com/developers/sql-api/reference/ loaded): 6 operations (GET/POST /sql, Batch Queries /sql/job CRUD), 17 schemas. Served from the gh-pages build of github.com/CartoDB/developers, last built 2018-04-17. Committed verbatim as upstream.yaml.

Vendor Maps API reference from the developers repo master branch (14 operations: anonymous maps, named-map template CRUD/instantiate/JSONP, static maps; 23 schemas). Preferred over the 2018 gh-pages build at cartodb.github.io/developers/maps-api/reference/swagger.yaml, which has only the 4 anonymous-map operations. Committed verbatim as upstream-maps.yaml, sha256:35d2b59fee9ecf2e03fe6cd07a1cb1f51ad0e5f3e6191ef7e14c7ca2e1e389e7.

Vendor Import API reference from the developers repo master branch (10 operations: /v1/imports, /v1/synchronizations incl. sync_now, /v3/visualization_exports; 11 schemas). Committed verbatim as upstream-import.yaml, sha256:c1cfc63596e2ff35d4ea06349faf4a7654aa5d719b8a3b4b27436d5948e6253c.
Vendor publishing bug: this URL serves the Auth API document byte-for-byte (same sha256 as auth-api/reference/swagger.yaml), so the master-branch Import API file above was used instead.

Vendor Auth API v3 reference (5 operations on /api_keys, 10 schemas). Its source (CartoDB/cartodb doc/developer-center/auth-api/reference) is no longer public, so the published build is the only vendor copy. Committed verbatim as upstream-auth.yaml, sha256:1c9cb9ac618eda3af557c3fda38396ad92756263228ec7f81d03bb6045516e9e.

Third-party 2024 snapshot of CartoDB-SQL-API (the vendor repo github.com/CartoDB/CartoDB-SQL-API is now private): a newer SQL API reference with 8 operations, adding POST /sql/copyfrom and GET /sql/copyto. Not a vendor source, so not committed as upstream; used only as evidence for those two COPY operations, which are in openapi.json flagged with x-openfn-source.

The Federated Tables API was the fifth Engine REST API with a Redoc reference (developers repo _app/federated-tables-api/reference/index.html points at ./swagger.yaml), but the yaml was never pushed to gh-pages, its source (CartoDB/cartodb) is private, and carto.com/developers/* now returns the CARTO 3 docs shell. Not covered. The Data Services API is a set of SQL functions called through /api/v2/sql, so it needs no paths of its own.

CARTO 3 (the current platform) publishes OpenAPI at api-docs.carto.com, but it is a different API on different hosts ({region}.api.carto.com/v3/...); the adaptor hard-codes https://{account}.carto.com/api/v2/sql, which only the legacy CARTO 2 Engine serves (still answering on 2026-11-13: an unknown account gets the SQL API's JSON 404 error).

Searched the org: CartoDB/developers (public, holds the reference yamls and the grunt config mapping each API to its source repo) and CartoDB/carto-python (public SDK). CartoDB-SQL-API, Windshaft-cartodb, cartodb and dataservices-api are no longer publicly readable (git ls-remote asks for credentials).
The official Python SDK also calls internal/undocumented routes (api/v1/viz, api/v1/tables, api/v4/kuviz, api/v4/do/*); with no vendor reference for their shapes they are not modelled.
No CARTO entry among 2529 apis.guru APIs.
No vendor-owned Postman workspace or SwaggerHub API for the CARTO 2 Engine APIs.

notes: The cartodb adaptor talks to CARTO's legacy CARTO 2 'Engine' platform: sql() and addRow() (which builds an INSERT with json-sql) both send GET https://{account}.carto.com/api/v2/sql?q=<statement>&api_key=<key> via superagent, and the adaptor exports no generic HTTP helper. CARTO published an OpenAPI 3.0 reference per Engine API, so this is a found-openapi capture of four vendor documents (SQL API v2, Maps API v1, Import API, Auth API v3), committed verbatim as upstream.yaml + upstream-{maps,import,auth}.yaml and merged into one openapi.json with mechanical transformations only: each document's paths are prefixed with its server base path (/api/v2, /api/v1, /api, /api/v3) under one server https://{user}.{domain}; components that clash with a different definition take the area prefix (MapsNotFound, MapsBadInput, MapsApiKeyQueryParam, AuthTimestamps, AuthUnauthorized); operations missing an operationId, or reusing one (the Maps reference gives 'instantiateAnonymousMap' to two operations), get one from method + path with the vendor's kept as x-upstream-operation-id; every operation carries x-carto-api naming its source document. Totals: 37 operations / 25 paths / 62 schemas = 6 SQL + 14 Maps + 10 Import + 5 Auth from the vendor files, plus POST /api/v2/sql/copyfrom and GET /api/v2/sql/copyto taken from a third-party snapshot of the newer (now private) SQL API reference and flagged with x-openfn-source. Completeness is best-effort, not complete, because the vendor's published SQL reference is a 2018 build that predates the COPY endpoints and the Federated Tables API reference was never published where it can still be fetched. CARTO 3 (api-docs.carto.com) is deliberately out of scope: different hosts and API, not reachable through this adaptor.
